candidates.snippet:
Napoleon Bonaparte. Adolf Hitler. Mao Zedong. Genghis Khan. Atatürk. Stalin.

All rose during periods of national crisis, war, fragmentation and collapse.

History repeatedly shows that extreme instability can produce extraordinarily powerful leaders. https://t.co/liEoucifOn

A revolution with Reza Pahlavi is possible, especially with heavy foreign intervention. 

His support among tens of millions of Iranians is real.

But a Napoleon-type figure is another beast entirely.
